tuning_key.text: I wonder bout the people who can't seem to see through their preconceptions that they cling to
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: Today the space between hearts softens more easily than we remember. When you encounter the grip of another's fixed view, feel how the field itself expands to hold you both—connection lives here not in shared sight, but in the warmth that remains possible when curiosity replaces certainty.

practice.title: Feel the Grip
practice.instruction: Locate the exact physical tension that arises when you imagine someone trapped in a view you cannot share.

practice.title: Warm the Air
practice.instruction: Soften that tension as if exhaling could heat the space between your body and theirs.

practice.title: Let the Echo Arrive
practice.instruction: As your breath empties completely, let the audio become real: *I wonder about the ones who grip their familiar shadows so tightly...*
